scope: Fresh authored questions for four pinned benchmark packs (pandas, prisma, starship, gh-cli), written by reading source only, before any search was run against these sources. Per pack and split: two natural-language implementation questions that avoid the exact identifier, and one exact-symbol control (category control). Development and validation draw only from their declared, disjoint subsystems. Labels are implementer-authored, source-bound and non-exhaustive (the primary file is listed first and becomes the scoped-page file_filter); they are not independent user or agent outcomes. Avoids the existing workflows.yaml and 2026-10-15 expansion questions for these packs.

acceptance.defined_in: The candidate freeze record, not this manifest. This manifest fixes only questions, labels and source hashes.
acceptance.validation: Held-out until the candidate is frozen; no product tuning after validation results are opened.
